reviews.title: Very well-made Stand) one issue though
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/E1h9EqVdTsL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/516XUnClb5L._SY256.jpg This is a very good quality made microphone arm. It is a little stiff and it is not 360° so you have limited movement but if you’re going to keep this stationary for the most part, it is top notch.  And please companies listen to me quit putting stickers on that rip off and leave sticker residue.

reviews.title: Works great
reviews.comment: Product is as described.  Was a gift for my 17 yr old grandson and he is very happy with it.

reviews.title: decent, but wouldnt buy again
reviews.comment: I had high hopes for this, its a decent arm but not a $70 one. its big and stiff. it does what its supposed to do but i wouldnt buy it again, youre not able to position it in many ways. putting it together was a headache but maybe i was just overthinking things.

reviews.title: Excellent Product
reviews.comment: I have tried several different types of mic arms and this one by far has got to be the absolute best. It is extremely sturdy and stylish. Exactly what I was looking for to go with my hyper x quadcast microphone. I would definitely purchase again if needed.
